def transform(grid):

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    solid_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]

    row_panels = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1)]
    col_panels = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds) - 1)]

    for pr, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_panels):
